data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Athalee is a goddess associated with the sea. Her name is derived from 'athalassia,' meaning 'sea,' and is sometimes translated as 'invincible.' She was often depicted with the horns of a goat and the tail of a fish, symbolizing her power over both land and water. The name Athalee carries the meaning “Goddess of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Athalee usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
